title: R6G exact elimination-width and junction feasibility gate

literature_basis.source: Dechter, Bucket elimination: A unifying framework for reasoning, Artificial Intelligence 113 (1999), DOI 10.1016/S0004-3702(99)00059-4
literature_basis.role: exact variable-elimination time and space are exponential in induced width, which depends on ordering

literature_basis.source: Yedidia, Freeman, and Weiss, Generalized Belief Propagation, NeurIPS 2000
literature_basis.role: larger regions can improve loopy-BP accuracy at adjustable complexity; region choice must therefore be measured rather than assumed

program_alignment.central_question: What structural growth is required to turn the exact R6D likelihood representation into controlled exact posterior inference?
program_alignment.epistemic_role: prerequisite feasibility audit after R6F showed exact global elimination but non-exact bounded local clustering
program_alignment.upstream_evidence: R6D likelihood and R6E messages are exact; R6F localizes residual error to bounded loopy inference
program_alignment.downstream_gate: do not implement generalized BP, correction, or LER sampling until region size or exact elimination width is measured

question.research_question: How do exact-preserving representation and elimination order change induced width from the 12-edge primitive graph to paper-normalized L=2?
question.smallest_claim: Deterministic induced-width upper bounds for registered graph/order pairs, plus exact primitive evidence checks where the predicted peak table is within the cap.
question.H1: bounded superfactor clustering lowers induced width relative to the unclustered R6D graph under at least one matched ordering
question.H2: global min-fill lowers induced width relative to either constrained group-first ordering
question.H3: paper-L2 projected peak tables remain exponential and exceed the exact numeric cap, blocking a naive junction-tree implementation
question.falsification: a symbolic-width inconsistency or primitive exact-evidence mismatch rejects the audit implementation; widths are upper bounds, not optimal treewidth proofs

orders: auxiliary_first_min_fill: greedily min-fill among remaining flow auxiliaries, then physical variables
physical_first_min_fill: greedily min-fill among remaining physical variables, then auxiliaries
global_min_fill: greedily min-fill among every remaining variable
matrix.tie_break: minimum fill-edge count, then current degree, variable class, and integer variable id
matrix.numeric_gate: on one fixed primitive maximum-candidate observation at p=0.10, run dense exact bucket elimination only when maximum cluster variables <=20; compare partition evidence with the registered 4096-mask exact target within 1e-10 relative error
matrix.budget: under ten CPU minutes and 2 GiB; zero correction, generalized-BP, LER, threshold, or performance samples

analysis.branch_logic: run all six representation/order branches on both geometries; numeric cap censors rather than approximates oversized primitive contractions
analysis.interpretation: induced widths are deterministic upper bounds for the registered heuristic orders, not proofs of minimum treewidth or scalable complexity
analysis.stop_rule: if every paper-L2 order has a peak cluster above 20 variables, report the structural barrier and route future work to controlled regions, cutset conditioning, or tensor-network approximations rather than implementing dense exact junction inference
